title: Motorcycle Chain
text: Implement motorcycle chain, 6 inputs, 4 outputs; {Coordinates, SprktFrPxz} sets the front sprocket position, {Mass moment of inertia, SprktFrIyy} sets the front sprocket inertia, {Radius, SprktFrR} sets the front sprocket radius, {Mass moment of inertia, SprktRrIyy} sets the rear sprocket inertia, {Radius, SprktRrR} sets the rear sprocket radius, {Mass moment of inertia, WhlRrIyy} sets the rear wheel inertia, {Radius, WhlRrR} sets the rear wheel radius, {Arm length, ArmRrLen} sets the swing arm length, {Stiffness, WhlDmpK} sets the wheel damper stiffness 1e4, {Damping, WhlDmpC} sets the wheel damping 1e2, {Equilibrium angle} sets the wheel damper equilibrium, {Rear sprocket angular velocity, SprktRrAngV0} sets the angular velocity and {Rear wheel angular velocity, WhlRrAngV0} sets the angular velocity. Values come from the instance.
